source_contract: Native01ca30 native-suffix branch changes the DB suffix, checks existing model identity, constructs/registers the actual model, obtains its actual Project, then calls08a9b0 using the supplied path. No extra readability preflight occurs on this recovered branch.
08a9b0 recognized moproj suffix records reader success in openedOk, but performs current-directory/remesh tail and returns accepted=true even when the read fails.

The already selected path can become absent/sharing-denied after dialog selection. File-dialog validation is outside the m2m supplied-path adapter boundary; it is not an extra original read between model creation and Project read.
Existing full Save later rejects openedOk=false before its write sequence. Earlier remesh refusal takes precedence when that dependency is reached first.
implementation: M2M_FLAG_WRITE_SAVE bypasses the adapter-only checkReadable. Legacy MST/MDT conversion profiles retain M2M_E_OPEN read-preflight behavior.
Existing full lifecycle actual model/read/current-selection pipeline is reused; no alternate parser or synthetic state callback is added.
The C ABI signature/version remain unchanged. The supported full-lifecycle status refinement is documented: E_PARSE at later rejected Save, or the earlier source-bound unsupported Open boundary.
guiViews construction before saveCurrent was reviewed: it stores only the Project reference; camera/state serialization is deferred to virtual use. It does not justify a speculative reordering fix.
validation: Actual DLL wide entry: absent selected moproj with valid remesh reaches E_PARSE, preserves remesh file, creates no project/MST, and retains adapter cwd restoration.
Absent selected moproj with unsupported remesh data reaches that Open reader refusal instead of masking it with E_OPEN; legacy flags still return E_OPEN.
Real sharing-denied project handle: original reader result reaches later Save rejection while legacy profile keeps preflight behavior.
Actual DLL UTF8 entry: rejected suffix returns E_PARSE before malformed remesh tail.
Full regression plus unchanged raw diagnostics and fixture hashes required.
qualifications: Normal Close cleanup, native feature-cache/refresh/dialog effects, and full original failed-Open equivalence remain separately queued.
E_PARSE/E_UNSUPPORTED are compatibility-adapter statuses, not invented GUI return codes.
No fresh original runtime comparison in this increment.
next: Continue actual accepted/rejected Open failure cleanup and Close ownership, native filesystem copy behavior, and shared layout/editor completion.
